en.topic_title: Chinese-origin Canadian NATO intern arrested on spying suspicions
en.topic_summary:
A Canadian citizen of Chinese origin suspected of carrying out “espionage on behalf of a third country” while on an internship at NATO has been arrested in Belgium, authorities said on Saturday.



NATO. Photo: NATO. 



The intern, who worked at the US-led defence alliance’s Supreme Headquarters Allied Powers Europe (SHAPE) in Mons, was arrested on Thursday, the Federal Prosecutor’s Office said.
